mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.model_code AS modelCode, m.model_name AS modelName, m.api_model AS apiModel, COALESCE(c.client_type, m.client_type) AS clientType, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.maxContextTokens')) AS SIGNED) AS maxContextTokens, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.maxOutputTokens')) AS SIGNED) AS maxOutputTokens, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.priority')) AS SIGNED) AS priority FROM ai_model_config m LEFT JOIN ai_client_config c ON c.id = m.client_id WHERE m.enabled = TRUE AND (m.client_id IS NULL OR c.enabled = TRUE) ORDER BY COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.priority')) AS SIGNED), 100) ASC, m.update_time DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT m.id, m.client_id, m.model_code, m.model_name, COALESCE(c.client_type, m.client_type) AS client_type, COALESCE(c.base_url, m.base_url) AS base_url, m.api_model, CASE WHEN m.client_id IS NULL THEN m.enabled ELSE (m.enabled AND c.enabled) END AS enabled, COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key) AS api_key, m.ext_json FROM ai_model_config m LEFT JOIN ai_client_config c ON c.id = m.client_id WHERE m.model_code = #{modelCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.client_id, m.model_code, m.model_name, COALESCE(c.client_type, m.client_type) AS client_type, COALESCE(c.base_url, m.base_url) AS base_url, m.api_model, CASE WHEN m.client_id IS NULL THEN m.enabled ELSE (m.enabled AND c.enabled) END AS enabled, COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key) AS api_key, m.ext_json FROM ai_model_config m LEFT JOIN ai_client_config c ON c.id = m.client_id WHERE m.id = #{modelId} LIMIT 1
